answer: A Sybil defense can rest on a jade seal earned through nadir audits. Each season the network picks a random quiet moment — the nadir — and asks an agent to recall one detail of a past job: the first line it wrote, the number it checked, the stranger it served. The question comes from its own history, so a real worker answers from memory, while a farm running fifty accounts cannot keep fifty histories straight; its answers blur and fail. Each passed audit stamps one jade mark; three marks open full standing, one failure burns a mark, and a yarrow seed of trust grows from honest recall.
